prime_certificate.certificate: n=k*2^m+1, odd k<2^m, a^((n-1)/2)=-1 mod n (Proth)

scope: Injection plus two fold-transversal HXY measurements, followed by noiseless code projection and logical HXY readout. No noisy pre-escape syndrome round; no escape.
